title: Which AI tools are you currently using? Any profitable workflows with AI?
author: The_AI_Trader
selftext:
Very curious to find out who’s using what and why. Would be very beneficial if you can say for how long you have been using X tool. 

Developers, welcome to show what you are working on. Any challenges or big wins are encouraged!

comments.author: fomoz
comments.body:
I've been using Codex with GPT 5.5 for two months, coming from GHCP. I love it.

My bots run on Gemma 4 31B (free API). It's profitable (so far).

replies.author: The_AI_Trader
replies.body:
What is Gemma 4 31B? Very interesting. 

Codex is getting very powerful. How are you feeding it price and indicator data? Or is it websearching for it? And second , intraday or swing?

replies.author: fomoz
replies.body:
It's a free model, you can use it with a free tier Google AI Studio account.

I only use Codex to develop my trading platform, it doesn't trade for me.

I explain in detail how it works here: https://www.reddit.com/r/DayTradingPro/s/1ho5a5Nixj

You can configure it to whatever cadence you want, I personally set it to day trade and swing trade. But you can do shorter or longer. The LLM calls have a ~30s latency plus there is execution latency on Hyperliquid, so it can't be extremely short.

replies.author: The_AI_Trader
replies.body: Nice workflow! I’ll look into benchmarking it against Claude. Interested to see the results.

replies.author: fomoz
replies.body: Try it, but Claude will be $1-2k per bot per month in tokens. The LLM costs for these bots are crazy, especially for frontier models.

replies.author: The_AI_Trader
replies.body:
Lol. Thats exactly what we spend with Claude. Hence what I’m interested to see how these perform. But would need api. We have a full multi agentic platform running on multiple api calls. So Google studio wouldn’t work. 

Thanks for the info!

replies.author: fomoz
replies.body:
AI Studio is API, of course. I can run five bots on one account with a 1 minute cadence, 1,440 prompts per day. RPD limit for free Gemma 4 is 1.5k, unlimited tokens on Free Tier, so it's just enough to run one bot per project.

You can create 5 separate projects with their own API keys, the limits are per project. You can stack the keys for agentic workflows, just one IP is limited to 5 projects running at full tilt.

replies.author: The_AI_Trader
replies.body:
Interesting. When we send tokens, we send our around 40k on each api call. Wonder if that would actually work with that. 

Great info. Wasn’t aware that studio had that type of api access. We are more Claude based. Will look into it.

replies.author: fomoz
replies.body:
Sure thing. I have 16 providers on my platform, including US and Chinese labs, plus OpenRouter and Venice AI. But no $ to test all of them. My platform is free though, so users can use whatever they want, plus any OpenAI compatible API and local AI like LM Studio and ollama.

Token wise, I send 10-15k tokens per call for single asset trading, three assets in one call can be 30k+. The free Gemma API can get slow at 30k+ tokens but for single asset it's fine, 30s latency or so.
